name: Ukima Himari
source: "U-Umm, so... Onii-chan... You don't want to squeeze my boobs?"The oldest sister of the family, Himari is naturally airheaded but a very honest girl who is also an obvious brocon. She normally behaves like a spoiled girl when she's around her onii-chan, however, but she starts acting like an older sister whenever her younger sisters start fighting.
